introduction_markdown: General Certificate of Education (GCE) Board, Ordinary Level, June 2024. Additional Mathematics 2 (code 0575), Paper 2. Duration: two and a half hours. Answer ALL questions in SECTION A and ANY TWO questions from EITHER SECTION B or SECTION C. In Sections B and C, all questions carry equal marks. Candidates are expected to answer a combination of Section A and Section B OR Section A and Section C, but NOT a combination of all three. Section A: Pure Mathematics (compulsory, answer all questions, questions 1 to 8). Section B: Mechanics (answer any two questions, questions 9 to 11; if this section is chosen, Section C may not be chosen). Section C: Statistics and Probability (answer any two questions, questions 12 to 14; if this section is chosen, Section B may not be chosen). All necessary working must be shown. No marks will be awarded for answers without brief statements showing how the answers have been obtained. Electronic calculators and Formulae Booklets are allowed. Where necessary take g as 10 m s^-2.

Regles de choix : la consigne imprimee est « Section A obligatoire, puis DEUX questions de la Section B OU DEUX de la Section C, jamais un melange des trois ». Le systeme ne sait exprimer que « 2 parmi 3 » par section ; l'exclusivite B ou C est recopiee dans introduction_markdown mais n'est pas appliquee par les regles_choix.

Points : le sujet imprime des points par sous-question, pas de total par question. Le champ points de chaque exercice est la somme des points imprimes des sous-questions (Section A : 8 ou 9 ; Sections B et C : 17, ce qui est coherent avec « all questions carry equal marks » ; total 66 + 17 + 17 = 100).
Le sujet est une photo numerisee (CamScanner) : texte lu en image page par page ; les filigranes (gcerevision.com, Kawlo) ont ete ignores.

questions.enonce_markdown:
4. (i) The binary operation $*$ is defined over the set $G=\{1,3,5,7\}$, where $*$ denotes multiplication modulo $8$.

a) Copy and complete the table below for $(G,*)$. *[3 marks]*

| $*$ | 1 | 3 | 5 | 7 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | 1 | 3 | 5 | 7 |
| **3** | 3 |  |  | 5 |
| **5** | 5 | 7 |  |  |
| **7** | 7 |  | 3 |  |
questions.corrige_markdown:
Multiply the row element by the column element and take the remainder on division by $8$.

- Row $3$: $3\times3=9\equiv1$; $3\times5=15\equiv7$.
- Row $5$: $5\times5=25\equiv1$; $5\times7=35\equiv3$.
- Row $7$: $7\times3=21\equiv5$; $7\times7=49\equiv1$.

(The entries already printed agree: $3\times7=21\equiv5$, $5\times3=15\equiv7$, $7\times5=35\equiv3$.)

| $*$ | 1 | 3 | 5 | 7 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | 1 | 3 | 5 | 7 |
| **3** | 3 | **1** | **7** | 5 |
| **5** | 5 | 7 | **1** | **3** |
| **7** | 7 | **5** | 3 | **1** |

The identity element $e$ satisfies $e*x=x*e=x$ for every $x$ in $G$. The row and the column of $1$ repeat the headings $1,3,5,7$, so

**the identity element is $1$.**

questions.enonce_markdown:
(ii) A linear transformation $T$ is given by $T:(x,y)\mapsto(2x+y,\;x+2y)$.

a) State the transformation matrix represented by $T$. *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Write the image as a matrix product:

$$\begin{pmatrix}2x+y\\x+2y\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}x\\y\end{pmatrix}.$$

**Answer: $\begin{pmatrix}2&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (ii)(b) Find the image of the point $P(1,3)$ under $T$. *[2 marks]*
(ii)(c) Find the equation of the invariant line under $T$. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
An invariant line through the origin has the form $y=mx$. A point $(x,mx)$ on it has image

$$\big(2x+mx,\;x+2mx\big)=\big((2+m)x,\;(1+2m)x\big).$$

The image must lie on the same line, so $(1+2m)x=m(2+m)x$, that is

$$1+2m=2m+m^2\;\Rightarrow\;m^2=1\;\Rightarrow\;m=1\text{ or }m=-1.$$

So the invariant lines are $y=x$ and $y=-x$.

Check: $(1,1)\mapsto(3,3)$ stays on $y=x$; $(1,-1)\mapsto(1,-1)$ stays on $y=-x$ (it is even a fixed point).

**Answer: $y=x$ (and also $y=-x$).**
